activity_context.topic_title: Finding the Inverse of a 3x3 Matrix Using Row Operations

feedback.problem:
Given the matrix
$B=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 0 \\ -5 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}],$ find ${B}^{-1}$ by performing row operations.
feedback.worked_solution:
We consider the augmented matrix $[B\,|\,I]$ where $I$ is the $3\times 3$ identity matrix. Applying the indicated row operations we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[B\,|\,I] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ -5 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] &  & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+5{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 5 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] &  & {R}_{2}:=-\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & -\frac{1}{2} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 5 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] &  \\  & =[I\,|\,{B}^{-1}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the inverse matrix is 

$$
{B}^{-1}=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -\frac{1}{2} & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$
